# 00000003824

**English.** Definition: The Nakajima monomial crystal M(λ) denotes the highest-weight monomial graph generated by monomial variables under Chevalley rules. Conjecture: M(λ) decomposes into connected components ⊕B(μ), where μ runs exactly over dominant integral weights bounded by λ in the dominance order, each appearing exactly once. (monomial component multiplicity-free)

**中文。** 定义：Nakajima 单项式晶体 M(λ) 指由单项式变元按 Chevalley 规则生成的最高权单项式图。猜想：M(λ) 的连通分量分解为直和 ⊕B(μ),其中 μ 恰取遍支配序下不超过 λ 的支配整权且每个恰出现一次。（单项式分量无重数）
